descFull: Pure-Rust inference engine for Qwen GGUF models (Qwen3 to Qwen3.8, dense and MoE up to 770B+). CUDA and Vulkan (NVIDIA, AMD), hybrid CPU+GPU experts, MTP speculative decoding, OpenAI and Anthropic compatible server. Up to ~1.7x llama.cpp decode on a 12 GB RTX 3060.
